text:
109 PRs merged this week. Agents learned to remember and collaborate, model discovery started showing its working, and the app catalog quietly turned into a busy little market. Also: more fallbacks, clearer diagnostics, better quests, and fewer places for software to pretend an error never happened. 🌱🐝

The garden is public: github.com/pollinations/pollinations
